description: Unit tests for the OgHttp2Session class in the HTTP/2 adapter, testing client and server behaviors, frame handling, request submission, and error scenarios.

classes.name: TestDataFrameSource
classes.description: A mock data source for testing, simulating request/response bodies with payload appending, ending, and read blocking.

methods.name: ProcessBytes
methods.description: Processes incoming frame bytes and returns the number of bytes processed or an error code.

methods.name: SubmitRequest
methods.description: Submits a new request with headers and optional body, returning a stream ID.

methods.name: SubmitResponse
methods.description: Submits a response for a given stream ID with headers and optional body.

methods.name: SubmitTrailer
methods.description: Submits trailer headers for a stream after response body is exhausted.

methods.name: want_write
methods.description: Indicates if the session has frames to write.

methods.name: want_read
methods.description: Indicates if the session expects to read frames.

methods.name: GetStreamUserData
methods.description: Retrieves user data associated with a stream.

methods.name: SetStreamUserData
methods.description: Associates user data with a stream.

methods.name: GetStreamSendWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the send window size for a stream.

methods.name: GetReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the current receive window size for the connection.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the receive window size for a specific stream.

methods.name: GetStreamReceiveWindowLimit
methods.description: Returns the receive window size limit for a stream.

methods.name: IsServerSession
methods.description: Returns true if the session is a server, false if client.

methods.name: GetHighestReceivedStreamId
methods.description: Returns the highest stream ID received.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Attempts to send queued frames, returns status.

methods.name: ResumeStream
methods.description: Resumes a stream that was previously blocked.
